svg.title: Airline pilot — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as airline pilot, wearing a flight uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A complete aircraft plan view has long swept wings, a narrow fuselage and a separate tailplane. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
